case.pattern_description: A shared-device fraud pattern was identified affecting multiple customers' cards. A single handset profile (SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080) was used to make purchases of $225.36-$244.98 on 28 different cards in the same weeks, each time appearing as a new device. This pattern matched four confirmed closed cases that could not be mapped to any known typology. The fraud was detected by tracing card -> transaction -> device in the TigerGraph database.

sar.narrative: Customer C01996, holder of card C01996-K2, is the subject of this report. Between 2016-11-16 15:24 and 2016-11-29 11:09, 2 transaction(s) totalling $470.34 were made on the card online from device profile 'SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080' through an anonymous proxy: $225.36 (3462447, 2016-11-16 15:24), $244.98 (3496814, 2016-11-29 11:09). The same device profile was used on 27 other customers' cards in the same period (C01289-K1, C02910-K1, C02975-K1, C03676-K2, C04108-K2, C04274-K1, C05448-K2, C06031-K2...), most of them behind anonymous proxies and each time as a new device, indicating a common actor. The activity is suspicious because: Device profile 'SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080' was used by 28 cards in a 60-day window around the alert; 28 of them behind an anonymous/hidden proxy and 28 flagged as a New device. 4 closed case(s) on cards that used this profile were confirmed fraud, 4 of them recorded as an undocumented pattern. It closely resembles earlier confirmed fraud cases CC-2649, CC-2985, CC-2971. The bank has recommended blocking and reissuing the card, placing linked cards under monitoring where applicable, and retains the transaction, device and investigation records as supporting documentation.
